title: [Bug] Claude Code: Fails to Complete Basic Code Editing Task
body:

top_comments.body: Sorry @mgoulet101, this was an error in automation. The original report had the tool_use error in the uploaded JSON. I'll tweak my script to be a little more careful.

top_comments.author: mattgodbolt
top_comments.body: going around in circles doing seds and awks trying to work around a simple change. Not sure what's different about this

top_comments.author: holstvoogd
top_comments.body:
It's been having a hard time the last few days. It's almost as if they randomly switch to some smaller model for a few days every few weeks. I've been fighting its stupidity for days.

For me it takes 6 attempts to do any thing because it just refuse to use the correct paths, never being able to edit a file with out 4 attempts and then deciding it might need to read it first. It's driving me insane, it is Gemini level stupid today. I just asked it to remove one comment, it started to remove ALL
